question: Where was the Americas Regional Office of the New Development Bank (NDB) announced to be established during the BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting in 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**São Paulo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Americas Regional Office of the **New Development Bank (NDB)** was announced to be established in São Paulo, Brazil, during the **BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting in 2018**.
 
• São Paulo, being one of the largest and most economically significant cities in Brazil, was selected to bolster the NDB's engagement in the Americas region.
 
• The New Development Bank, established by the BRICS nations (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa), aims to **mobilize resources for infrastructure and sustainable development projects** in emerging economies.
 
• The Americas Regional Office in São Paulo plays a crucial role in identifying and financing development projects in the region, particularly focusing on areas such as energy, transport, and urban development.
 
• The establishment of this office underscores the NDB's commitment to enhancing its global outreach and strengthening collaboration with member countries in the Americas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mexico City:**
 
 
• Mexico City is the capital and largest city of Mexico, known for being a cultural and financial hub in Latin America.
 
• While it is a prominent city in the Americas, it was not chosen for the establishment of the NDB's Americas Regional Office.
 
 
 
• **Buenos Aires:**
 
 
• Buenos Aires is the capital of Argentina and a major economic center in South America.
 
• It plays a significant role in regional trade and finance but was not selected as the location for the NDB's regional office.
 
 
 
• **Lima:**
 
 
• Lima is the capital of Peru and an important city in the Pacific region of South America.
 
• Despite its strategic position, it was not chosen as the location for the NDB's Americas Regional Office.
 
 
 
• **New Development Bank (NDB):**
 
 
• The NDB was established in 2014 by the BRICS nations to support infrastructure and sustainable development projects in emerging economies.
 
• The bank's headquarters is located in Shanghai, China, and it has regional offices in South Africa, Russia, and Brazil.
 
• The institution aims to foster economic growth, reduce the infrastructure gap, and promote sustainable development in member countries.
